paragraphs.body: Dallas Cowboys | Official Site of the Dallas Cowboys reported that quarterback Dak Prescott described the team's recent loss to the Arizona Cardinals as 'one of the toughest' in his career. Yahoo Sports noted that fans expressed frustration, with some shouting 'Shut Up' and 'Stop Taking Bullets for Him' after Prescott shielded head coach Brian Schottenheimer following the overtime defeat. FOX Sports highlighted a specific play where Prescott scrambled for a five-yard touchdown run to extend the Cowboys' lead during the game.

headline: Dak Prescott calls Cardinals loss 'one of the toughest' after shielding Schottenheimer amid fan frustration.
